lead: Javed Akhtar is a widely followed Indian screenwriter, born on 17 January 1945 in Khairabad.
As of 2026, he is 81 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.

sections.heading: Javed Akhtar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Javed Akhtar was born on 17 January 1945 in Khairabad, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Jan Nisar Akhtar. He is a sibling of Salman Akhtar.
He studied at Aligarh Muslim University and Minto Circle.
He is recorded as speaking Urdu.

sections.heading: Javed Akhtar — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists screenwriter, writer, poet, lyricist, songwriter and politician as his occupations.
He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (2010–2016).
